requirements:
autopep8
rope
jedi
pycodestyle
PyQt5
flake8
importlib_metadata
ujson
parso
pytest
docstring_to_markdown
pylsp
pluggy
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-m", "spyder"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt from detected imports (excluding empty string and 'spyder' which is the main package). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs requirements, copies code, and sets default command to run Spyder IDE.
